name: Indian Cove day-use lot at the end of the Rattlesnake Canyon road
basis: Mountain Project Rattlesnake Canyon page: 'From the vicinity of the Short Wall drive east and then south to a large parking area at the end of the road'; the canyon approach starts from there (trail east to a wash, then south). Trail guides place the picnic/day-use area at the east edge of the campground at the end of a side road, with the Rattlesnake Canyon wash just east of it. Road check: the 'Indian Cove Road East' service road ends at 34.0868,-116.1416 and this lot is 0.01 km from that end (two other day-use lots at 34.0853,-116.1404 and 34.0864,-116.1427 are within 0.08 km, same spot); the OSM Rattlesnake Canyon relation centre is 0.5 km away.

name: Indian Cove day-use lot at the east end of the Short Wall
basis: Mountain Project Short Wall page: 'Day use parking is available at the eastern end of the wall with room for approximately 8 vehicles' and the wall is on the left 'just before two roads merge into one'. Road check on Indian Cove Circle East / Indian Cove Road East: this lot is 0.04-0.07 km from the road at the wall's east end and 0.07 km from the wall's mapped coordinate; the other day-use lots near (34.0928,-116.1543) sit at the wall's west end, so the easternmost was chosen.
